WITH role_counts AS (
  SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) AS matches
  FROM main.player_match
  WHERE role IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY player_id, role
),
role_ranks AS (
  SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY matches DESC) AS role_rank, player_id
  FROM role_counts
),
delivery_checks AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS deliveries,
         SUM(b.striker IS NULL) AS missing_striker,
         SUM(b.bowler IS NULL) AS missing_bowler,
         SUM(s.match_id IS NULL) AS missing_score_row,
         SUM(s.match_id IS NOT NULL AND s.runs_scored IS NULL) AS null_scores
  FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
  LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
)
SELECT 'dismissal_kind' AS check_name, COALESCE(w.kind_out, '<NULL>') AS category,
       COUNT(*) AS records,
       SUM(b.match_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_deliveries,
       SUM(w.player_out IS NULL) AS missing_player
FROM main.wicket_taken AS w
LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
GROUP BY w.kind_out
UNION ALL SELECT 'role', COALESCE(role, '<NULL>'), COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM main.player_match GROUP BY role
UNION ALL SELECT 'tied_top_role', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL
  FROM (SELECT player_id FROM role_ranks WHERE role_rank = 1 GROUP BY player_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'players', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL FROM main.player
UNION ALL SELECT 'players_without_match', NULL, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL
  FROM main.player AS p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM main.player_match AS pm WHERE pm.player_id = p.player_id)
UNION ALL SELECT 'deliveries', NULL, deliveries, missing_striker, missing_bowler FROM delivery_checks
UNION ALL SELECT 'scores', NULL, missing_score_row, null_scores, NULL FROM delivery_checks;

arguments.sql:
WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           role,
           SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_matches_played,
           RANK() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY role IS NULL, COUNT(*) DESC
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
appearances AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           GROUP_CONCAT(role, ', ') AS most_frequent_role,
           MAX(total_matches_played) AS total_matches_played
    FROM (
        SELECT player_id, role, total_matches_played
        FROM role_counts
        WHERE role_rank = 1
        ORDER BY player_id, role
    )
    GROUP BY player_id
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.striker AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(s.runs_scored) AS runs_scored,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.striker, b.match_id
),
batting_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs_scored,
           MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_score,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 30) AS matches_with_30_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 50) AS matches_with_50_plus,
           SUM(runs_scored >= 100) AS matches_with_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id,
           COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT b.bowler AS player_id,
           b.match_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0)) AS runs_given,
           -- Count recorded deliveries for economy while ignoring the extra-runs data.
           COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 END) AS wickets_taken
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    GROUP BY b.bowler, b.match_id
),
bowling_career AS (
    SELECT player_id,
           wickets_taken || '-' || runs_given AS best_bowling_performance,
           SUM(wickets_taken) OVER player_matches AS total_wickets_taken,
           SUM(runs_given) OVER player_matches AS total_runs_given,
           SUM(balls_bowled) OVER player_matches AS total_balls_bowled,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id
               ORDER BY wickets_taken DESC, runs_given, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
    WINDOW player_matches AS (PARTITION BY player_id)
)
SELECT p.player_id,
       p.player_name,
       a.most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand,
       p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) AS total_runs_scored,
       COALESCE(a.total_matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(bt.total_runs_scored, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       bt.highest_score,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_30_plus, 0) AS matches_with_30_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_50_plus, 0) AS matches_with_50_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.matches_with_100_plus, 0) AS matches_with_100_plus,
       COALESCE(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * bt.total_runs_scored / NULLIF(bt.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(bw.total_wickets_taken, 0) AS total_wickets_taken,
       6.0 * bw.total_runs_given / NULLIF(bw.total_balls_bowled, 0) AS economy_rate,
       bw.best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN appearances AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN batting_career AS bt ON bt.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling_career AS bw ON bw.player_id = p.player_id AND bw.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id

WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) AS matches_in_role
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
ranked_roles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role,
           SUM(matches_in_role) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS matches_played,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY matches_in_role DESC, role
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM role_counts
),
deliveries AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, b.bowler,
           COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs,
           CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bowler_wicket
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT striker AS player_id, match_id, SUM(runs) AS match_runs,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY striker, match_id
),
batting AS (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs,
           MAX(match_runs) AS highest_score,
           SUM(match_runs >= 30) AS matches_30_plus,
           SUM(match_runs >= 50) AS matches_50_plus,
           SUM(match_runs >= 100) AS matches_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT bowler AS player_id, match_id, SUM(bowler_wicket) AS wickets,
           SUM(runs) AS runs_given, COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowling AS (
    SELECT player_id, wickets, runs_given,
           SUM(wickets) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_wickets,
           6.0 * SUM(runs_given) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id)
               / SUM(balls_bowled) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS economy_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, r.role AS most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(b.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
       COALESCE(r.matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(b.total_runs, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       COALESCE(b.highest_score, 0) AS highest_score,
       COALESCE(b.matches_30_plus, 0) AS matches_30_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_50_plus, 0) AS matches_50_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_100_plus, 0) AS matches_100_plus,
       COALESCE(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * b.total_runs / NULLIF(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(w.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets,
       w.economy_rate,
       w.wickets || '-' || w.runs_given AS best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN ranked_roles AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.role_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN batting AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling AS w ON w.player_id = p.player_id AND w.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id

SQL: WITH role_counts AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) AS matches_in_role
    FROM main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
ranked_roles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role,
           SUM(matches_in_role) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS matches_played,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY matches_in_role DESC, role
           ) AS role_rank
    FROM role_counts
),
deliveries AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.striker, b.bowler,
           COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) AS runs,
           CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN (
               'bowled', 'caught', 'caught and bowled', 'hit wicket', 'lbw', 'stumped'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bowler_wicket
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
    LEFT JOIN main.wicket_taken AS w USING (match_id, over_id, ball_id, innings_no)
),
batting_by_match AS (
    SELECT striker AS player_id, match_id, SUM(runs) AS match_runs,
           COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY striker, match_id
),
batting AS (
    SELECT player_id, SUM(match_runs) AS total_runs,
           MAX(match_runs) AS highest_score,
           SUM(match_runs >= 30) AS matches_30_plus,
           SUM(match_runs >= 50) AS matches_50_plus,
           SUM(match_runs >= 100) AS matches_100_plus,
           SUM(balls_faced) AS total_balls_faced
    FROM batting_by_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out AS player_id, COUNT(*) AS total_dismissals
    FROM main.wicket_taken
    WHERE kind_out <> 'retired hurt'
    GROUP BY player_out
),
bowling_by_match AS (
    SELECT bowler AS player_id, match_id, SUM(bowler_wicket) AS wickets,
           SUM(runs) AS runs_given, COUNT(*) AS balls_bowled
    FROM deliveries
    GROUP BY bowler, match_id
),
bowling AS (
    SELECT player_id, wickets, runs_given,
           SUM(wickets) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS total_wickets,
           6.0 * SUM(runs_given) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id)
               / SUM(balls_bowled) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id) AS economy_rate,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY wickets DESC, runs_given, match_id
           ) AS performance_rank
    FROM bowling_by_match
)
SELECT p.player_id, p.player_name, r.role AS most_frequent_role,
       p.batting_hand, p.bowling_skill,
       COALESCE(b.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
       COALESCE(r.matches_played, 0) AS total_matches_played,
       COALESCE(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS total_dismissals,
       1.0 * COALESCE(b.total_runs, 0) / NULLIF(d.total_dismissals, 0) AS batting_average,
       COALESCE(b.highest_score, 0) AS highest_score,
       COALESCE(b.matches_30_plus, 0) AS matches_30_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_50_plus, 0) AS matches_50_plus,
       COALESCE(b.matches_100_plus, 0) AS matches_100_plus,
       COALESCE(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS total_balls_faced,
       100.0 * b.total_runs / NULLIF(b.total_balls_faced, 0) AS strike_rate,
       COALESCE(w.total_wickets, 0) AS total_wickets,
       w.economy_rate,
       w.wickets || '-' || w.runs_given AS best_bowling_performance
FROM main.player AS p
LEFT JOIN ranked_roles AS r ON r.player_id = p.player_id AND r.role_rank = 1
LEFT JOIN batting AS b ON b.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN dismissals AS d ON d.player_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN bowling AS w ON w.player_id = p.player_id AND w.performance_rank = 1
ORDER BY p.player_id
LIMIT 1000

WITH team_lineups AS (
    SELECT id AS match_id,
           CASE WHEN home_team_goal > away_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               home_player_1, home_player_2, home_player_3, home_player_4,
               home_player_5, home_player_6, home_player_7, home_player_8,
               home_player_9, home_player_10, home_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal

    UNION ALL

    SELECT id AS match_id,
           CASE WHEN away_team_goal > home_team_goal THEN 'Win' ELSE 'Loss' END AS outcome,
           json_array(
               away_player_1, away_player_2, away_player_3, away_player_4,
               away_player_5, away_player_6, away_player_7, away_player_8,
               away_player_9, away_player_10, away_player_11
           ) AS lineup
    FROM main."Match"
    WHERE home_team_goal <> away_team_goal
),
player_totals AS (
    SELECT t.outcome,
           slot.value AS player_api_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.match_id) AS match_count
    FROM team_lineups AS t
    CROSS JOIN json_each(t.lineup) AS slot
    WHERE slot.value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.outcome, slot.value
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT outcome, player_api_id, match_count,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY outcome ORDER BY match_count DESC) AS outcome_rank
    FROM player_totals
)
SELECT r.outcome, p.player_name, r.match_count
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN main.Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
WHERE r.outcome_rank = 1
ORDER BY CASE r.outcome WHEN 'Win' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, p.player_name

WITH map_keys AS (

), monthly_interests AS (

WITH product_month_sales AS (
  SELECT s.prod_id, t.calendar_year AS sales_year, t.calendar_month_number AS month,
         SUM(s.amount_sold) AS amount
  FROM main.sales AS s
  JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
  JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
  JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
  JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
  JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
  WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
    AND p.promo_total_id = 1 AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020, 2021)
  GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
by_product_month AS (
  SELECT month, prod_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2019 THEN amount END) AS sales_2019,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2020 THEN amount END) AS sales_2020,
         MAX(CASE WHEN sales_year = 2021 THEN amount END) AS sales_2021
  FROM product_month_sales
  GROUP BY month, prod_id
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT month,
         COUNT(sales_2019) AS products_2019,
         COUNT(sales_2020) AS products_2020,
         COUNT(sales_2021) AS products_2021,
         SUM(sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL) AS paired_products,
         SUM(sales_2019 = 0 AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL) AS zero_baselines,
         SUM(sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2021 IS NULL) AS paired_without_2021,
         SUM(sales_2021 IS NOT NULL AND (sales_2019 IS NULL OR sales_2020 IS NULL)) AS actual_without_pair
  FROM by_product_month
  GROUP BY month
),
rates AS (
  SELECT month, COUNT(*) AS rate_rows, MIN(to_us) AS min_rate, MAX(to_us) AS max_rate
  FROM main.currency
  WHERE country = 'France' AND year = 2021
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT coverage.*, rates.rate_rows, rates.min_rate, rates.max_rate
FROM coverage
LEFT JOIN rates USING (month)
ORDER BY month

    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_year, t.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT target.month,
           ROUND(AVG(
               (
                   (recent.amount - prior.amount) / NULLIF(prior.amount, 0)
                   * recent.amount + recent.amount
               ) * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1.0)
           ), 2) AS average_projected_sales_usd
    FROM product_month_sales AS target
    LEFT JOIN product_month_sales AS prior
      ON prior.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND prior.month = target.month

      ON recent.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND recent.month = target.month
     AND recent.sales_year = 2020
    LEFT JOIN main.currency AS fx
      ON fx.country = 'France'
     AND fx.year = target.sales_year
     AND fx.month = target.month
    WHERE target.sales_year = 2021
    GROUP BY target.month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT average_projected_sales_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_projected_sales_usd) AS month_rank,

    FROM monthly_averages
    WHERE average_projected_sales_usd IS NOT NULL
)

WITH product_month_sales AS (
    SELECT
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2019 THEN s.amount_sold END) AS sales_2019,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.calendar_year = 2020 THEN s.amount_sold END) AS sales_2020
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.customers AS c ON c.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND t.calendar_year IN (2019, 2020)
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number
),
projections AS (
    SELECT
        month,
        sales_2020 + sales_2020 * (
            1.0 * (sales_2020 - sales_2019) / NULLIF(sales_2019, 0)
        ) AS projected_sales
    FROM product_month_sales
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT
        p.month,
        ROUND(AVG(p.projected_sales * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1.0)), 2) AS avg_usd
    FROM projections AS p

WITH salary_formats AS (
    SELECT
        Location,
        Salary,
        CASE WHEN instr(Salary, '/') > 0
             THEN substr(Salary, instr(Salary, '/'))

             ELSE Salary
        END AS amount_text
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
),
profile AS (

)
SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT Location) AS locations,
    MIN(Salary) AS example_salary,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount IS NULL OR amount = '' OR amount GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unusual_amounts,
    MIN(CASE WHEN amount IS NULL OR amount = '' OR amount GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
             THEN Salary END) AS unusual_example
FROM profile
GROUP BY suffix
ORDER BY records DESC

WITH RECURSIVE salary_digits(Location, CompanyName, remaining_text, digits) AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, Salary, ''
    FROM main.SalaryDataset
    WHERE Salary IS NOT NULL

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        substr(remaining_text, 2),
        digits || CASE
            WHEN substr(remaining_text, 1, 1) GLOB '[0-9]'
                THEN substr(remaining_text, 1, 1)
            ELSE ''
        END
    FROM salary_digits
    WHERE remaining_text <> ''
),
cleaned_salaries AS (
    -- Average the stored amounts after stripping currency and pay-period text.
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, CAST(digits AS REAL) AS salary_amount
    FROM salary_digits
    WHERE remaining_text = '' AND digits <> ''
),
city_company_averages AS (
    SELECT Location, CompanyName, AVG(salary_amount) AS city_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
    WHERE Location IN ('Mumbai', 'Pune', 'New Delhi', 'Hyderabad')
    GROUP BY Location, CompanyName
),
ranked_companies AS (
    SELECT
        Location,
        CompanyName,
        city_average,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Location
            ORDER BY city_average DESC, CompanyName
        ) AS city_rank
    FROM city_company_averages
),
national_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(salary_amount) AS country_average
    FROM cleaned_salaries
)
SELECT
    ranked_companies.Location AS "Location",
    ranked_companies.CompanyName AS "Company Name",
    ranked_companies.city_average AS "Average Salary in State",
    national_average.country_average AS "Average Salary in Country"
FROM ranked_companies
CROSS JOIN national_average
WHERE ranked_companies.city_rank <= 5
ORDER BY ranked_companies.Location, ranked_companies.city_rank
LIMIT 20

WITH model_types AS (

    FROM main.solution_ext

    GROUP BY name, version, step
),
status_models AS (

    FROM main.stack_ok
    GROUP BY status, L1_model, name, version
)
SELECT status, L1_model,
       COUNT(*) AS model_count,
       SUM(qualifying_steps) AS step_count,

            SELECT 1 FROM step_types AS m
            WHERE m.name = s.name AND m.version = s.version AND m.step = s.step

FROM status_models
GROUP BY status, L1_model
ORDER BY status, L1_model

arguments.sql:
WITH helmet_parties AS (
    SELECT p.case_id, p.party_type, p.statewide_vehicle_type,
           p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
               OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used') AS used,
           p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
               OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used') AS not_used
    FROM main.parties AS p
    WHERE p.party_safety_equipment_1 LIKE '%helmet%' OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 LIKE '%helmet%'
),
collision_counts AS (
    SELECT motorcycle_collision, COUNT(*) AS rows, COUNT(DISTINCT case_id) AS cases,
           COUNT(*) - COUNT(motorcyclist_killed_count) AS missing_fatality_counts
    FROM main.collisions
    GROUP BY motorcycle_collision
),
helmet_cases AS (
    SELECT p.case_id, MAX(p.used) AS used, MAX(p.not_used) AS not_used
    FROM helmet_parties AS p
    JOIN main.collisions AS c ON c.case_id = p.case_id
    WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1 AND p.party_type IN ('driver', 'passenger')
    GROUP BY p.case_id
)
SELECT 'collision flag / case uniqueness / missing fatalities' AS diagnostic,
       CAST(motorcycle_collision AS TEXT) AS category, rows AS count_1, cases AS count_2,
       missing_fatality_counts AS count_3
FROM collision_counts
UNION ALL
SELECT 'party types with explicit helmet codes in motorcycle collisions', p.party_type, COUNT(*),
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN p.not_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM helmet_parties AS p
JOIN main.collisions AS c ON c.case_id = p.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
GROUP BY p.party_type
UNION ALL
SELECT 'driver or passenger collision-level helmet statuses', 'used / not used / both',
       SUM(CASE WHEN used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), SUM(CASE WHEN not_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
       SUM(CASE WHEN used AND not_used THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM helmet_cases

WITH collision_helmet_use AS (
    SELECT
        c.case_id,
        c.motorcyclist_killed_count,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet used')
            THEN 1 ELSE 0

        MAX(CASE
            WHEN p.party_safety_equipment_1 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')
              OR p.party_safety_equipment_2 IN ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 'passenger, motorcycle helmet not used')

    FROM main.collisions AS c
    JOIN main.parties AS p ON p.case_id = c.case_id

WITH helmet_codes(equipment, helmet_used) AS (
    VALUES
        ('driver, motorcycle helmet used', 1),
        ('passenger, motorcycle helmet used', 1),
        ('driver, motorcycle helmet not used', 0),
        ('passenger, motorcycle helmet not used', 0)
),
collision_groups AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.case_id, h.helmet_used
    FROM main.parties AS p
    JOIN helmet_codes AS h
      ON h.equipment IN (p.party_safety_equipment_1, p.party_safety_equipment_2)
)
SELECT
    100.0 * SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE g.helmet_used = 1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.helmet_used = 1), 0) AS helmet_used_fatality_pct,
    100.0 * SUM(c.motorcyclist_killed_count) FILTER (WHERE g.helmet_used = 0)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE g.helmet_used = 0), 0) AS helmet_not_used_fatality_pct
FROM main.collisions AS c
JOIN collision_groups AS g ON g.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.motorcycle_collision = 1
LIMIT 1

WITH sales_by_code AS (
    SELECT product_code, MIN(date) AS first_date, MAX(date) AS last_date,
           COUNT(*) AS sales_rows, COUNT(sold_quantity) AS quantity_rows
    FROM main.hardware_fact_sales_monthly
    WHERE date >= '2021-01-01' AND date < '2022-01-01'
    GROUP BY product_code
),
product_counts AS (
    SELECT division, product, COUNT(*) AS codes_per_product
    FROM main.hardware_dim_product
    GROUP BY division, product
),
dimension_counts AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS dimension_rows,
           COUNT(DISTINCT product_code) AS unique_codes,
           COUNT(DISTINCT division) AS divisions,
           SUM(product IS NULL OR division IS NULL) AS unlabeled_codes
    FROM main.hardware_dim_product
)
SELECT d.*,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product_counts) AS named_products,
       (SELECT MAX(codes_per_product) FROM product_counts) AS max_codes_per_product,
       MIN(s.first_date) AS first_sales_date,
       MAX(s.last_date) AS last_sales_date,
       SUM(s.sales_rows) AS sales_rows,
       SUM(s.quantity_rows) AS quantity_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.product_code IS NULL THEN s.sales_rows ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_sales_rows
FROM sales_by_code AS s
LEFT JOIN main.hardware_dim_product AS p ON p.product_code = s.product_code
CROSS JOIN dimension_counts AS d

WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, customer_id
    FROM main.olist_orders
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
delivered_items AS (
    SELECT i.*
    FROM main.olist_order_items AS i
    JOIN delivered_orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
),
five_star_reviews AS (
    SELECT r.order_id, r.review_id
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews AS r
    JOIN delivered_orders AS o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.review_score = 5
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_orders) AS delivered_orders,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM delivered_orders) AS distinct_delivered_order_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM main.olist_customers) AS nonunique_or_null_customer_keys,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_items) AS delivered_items,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_items AS i
     JOIN delivered_orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
     JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id) AS items_joined_to_customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_items
     WHERE price IS NULL OR freight_value IS NULL OR seller_id IS NULL) AS items_with_missing_fields,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM delivered_items
     WHERE price <> ROUND(price, 2) OR freight_value <> ROUND(freight_value, 2)) AS items_with_fractional_cents,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM five_star_reviews) AS five_star_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT review_id) FROM five_star_reviews) AS distinct_five_star_review_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT order_id, review_id FROM five_star_reviews)) AS distinct_five_star_order_review_pairs,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM five_star_reviews) AS five_star_orders

arguments.sql:
WITH seller_orders AS (
    SELECT i.seller_id,
           o.order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           SUM(i.price - i.freight_value) AS order_profit
    FROM main.olist_orders AS o
    JOIN main.olist_order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY i.seller_id, o.order_id, o.customer_id
),
five_star_reviews AS (
    SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS rating_count
    FROM main.olist_order_reviews
    WHERE review_score = 5
    GROUP BY order_id
),
seller_metrics AS (
    SELECT so.seller_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS customer_count,
           ROUND(SUM(so.order_profit), 2) AS profit,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count,
           SUM(COALESCE(r.rating_count, 0)) AS five_star_count
    FROM seller_orders AS so
    LEFT JOIN main.olist_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = so.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN five_star_reviews AS r ON r.order_id = so.order_id
    GROUP BY so.seller_id
),
achievements AS (
    SELECT 1 AS category_order, 'Most distinct customer unique IDs' AS achievement,
           seller_id, customer_count AS value
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'Highest total profit', seller_id, profit
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, 'Most distinct orders', seller_id, order_count
    FROM seller_metrics
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, 'Most 5-star ratings', seller_id, five_star_count
    FROM seller_metrics
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT category_order, achievement, seller_id, value,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY category_order
               ORDER BY value DESC, seller_id
           ) AS position
    FROM achievements
)
SELECT achievement, seller_id, value
FROM ranked
WHERE position = 1
ORDER BY category_order
LIMIT 4

WITH team_matches AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
        home_team_goal AS goals_for,
        away_team_goal AS goals_against
    FROM main."Match"
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        away_team_api_id,
        away_team_goal,
        home_team_goal
    FROM main."Match"
),
season_points AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN goals_for > goals_against THEN 3
            WHEN goals_for = goals_against THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS total_points
    FROM team_matches
    GROUP BY season, league_id, country_id, team_api_id
),
ranked_teams AS (
    SELECT
        season,
        league_id,
        country_id,
        team_api_id,
        total_points,
        RANK() OVER (
            PARTITION BY season
            ORDER BY total_points DESC
        ) AS points_rank
    FROM season_points
)
SELECT
    r.season,
    t.team_long_name AS team_name,
    l.name AS league,
    c.name AS country,
    r.total_points
FROM ranked_teams AS r
JOIN main.Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = r.team_api_id
JOIN main.League AS l ON l.id = r.league_id
JOIN main.Country AS c ON c.id = r.country_id
WHERE r.points_rank = 1
ORDER BY r.season, team_name, league, country

WITH customer_months AS (
    SELECT tx.customer_id, DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
           COUNT(CASE WHEN tx.txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal') THEN 1 END) AS eligible_rows
    FROM main.customer_transactions AS tx

WITH monthly_net AS (
    SELECT
        tx.customer_id,
        DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
        SUM(CASE tx.txn_type
            WHEN 'deposit' THEN tx.txn_amount
            WHEN 'withdrawal' THEN -tx.txn_amount
        END) AS net_amount
    FROM main.customer_transactions AS tx
    WHERE tx.txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
    GROUP BY tx.customer_id, DATE(tx.txn_date, 'start of month')
),
monthly_balances AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        month_start,
        SUM(net_amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY month_start
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS closing_balance,
        net_amount
    FROM monthly_net
),
latest_balances AS (
    SELECT
        closing_balance,
        closing_balance - net_amount AS prior_month_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_start DESC
        ) AS month_rank
    FROM monthly_balances
),
customer_growth AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN prior_month_balance = 0 THEN closing_balance * 100.0
            ELSE (closing_balance - prior_month_balance) * 100.0 / prior_month_balance
        END AS growth_rate
    FROM latest_balances
    WHERE month_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN growth_rate > 5 THEN 1 END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage_of_customers
FROM customer_growth
LIMIT 1

WITH last_rounds AS (
    SELECT year, MAX(round) AS round
    FROM main.races
    WHERE year IN (1988, 2007)
    GROUP BY year
),
comparison AS (
    SELECT r.year, 'driver standings' AS source, s.driver_id AS entity_id, s.points
    FROM last_rounds AS l
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = l.year AND r.round = l.round
    JOIN main.driver_standings AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = 1988
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.year, 'driver results', s.driver_id, SUM(s.points)
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = 1988
    GROUP BY r.year, s.driver_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.year, 'constructor standings', s.constructor_id, s.points
    FROM last_rounds AS l
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.year = l.year AND r.round = l.round
    JOIN main.constructor_standings AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = 2007
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.year, 'constructor results', s.constructor_id, SUM(s.points)
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.constructor_results AS s ON s.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year = 2007
    GROUP BY r.year, s.constructor_id
),
ranked AS (

FROM ranked AS p
LEFT JOIN main.drivers_ext AS d ON p.year = 1988 AND d.driver_id = p.entity_id
LEFT JOIN main.constructors AS c ON p.year = 2007 AND c.constructor_id = p.entity_id

WITH session_bounds AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp, MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
    GROUP BY session
),
endpoint_ties AS (
    SELECT log.session, log.stamp
    FROM activity_log AS log
    JOIN session_bounds AS bounds
      ON log.session = bounds.session
     AND log.stamp IN (bounds.first_stamp, bounds.last_stamp)
    WHERE log.action = 'view'
    GROUP BY log.session, log.stamp
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT log.path) > 1
)
SELECT action,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT path) AS path_count,
       SUM(path IS NULL OR path = '') AS missing_paths,
       SUM(session IS NULL OR session = '') AS missing_sessions,
       SUM(stamp IS NULL OR datetime(stamp) IS NULL OR stamp <> datetime(stamp)) AS noncanonical_stamps,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM endpoint_ties) AS tied_endpoint_count
FROM activity_log
GROUP BY action
ORDER BY action

    SELECT session,
           MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp,
           MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp,
           MIN(CASE WHEN path <> '' THEN stamp END) AS first_known_path_stamp,
           MAX(CASE WHEN path <> '' THEN stamp END) AS last_known_path_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT log."option", log.search_type,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_with_empty_path,
       SUM(log.stamp = bounds.first_stamp) AS at_first_timestamp,
       SUM(log.stamp = bounds.last_stamp) AS at_last_timestamp,
       SUM(bounds.first_stamp <> bounds.first_known_path_stamp) AS changed_first_timestamp,
       SUM(bounds.last_stamp <> bounds.last_known_path_stamp) AS changed_last_timestamp
FROM activity_log AS log
JOIN session_bounds AS bounds ON log.session = bounds.session
WHERE log.path = ''
GROUP BY log."option", log.search_type

arguments.sql:
WITH run_entries AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
run_totals AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM run_entries
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
bowling AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, COUNT(DISTINCT bowler) AS bowler_count,
           COUNT(*) - COUNT(bowler) AS missing_bowlers
    FROM main.ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
overs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id, b.bowler_count, b.missing_bowlers,
           COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs
    FROM bowling AS b
    LEFT JOIN run_totals AS r USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC) AS run_rank,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
           ) AS chronological_rank
    FROM overs
),
winning AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE run_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."match") AS matches_in_catalog,
    COUNT(DISTINCT winning.match_id) AS matches_with_overs,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."match" AS m
     WHERE m.match_id NOT IN (SELECT match_id FROM bowling)) AS matches_without_overs,
    COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT winning.match_id) AS additional_tied_winners,
    SUM(bowler_count > 1) AS winning_overs_with_multiple_bowlers,
    SUM(bowler_count = 0) AS winning_overs_without_bowler,
    SUM(missing_bowlers > 0) AS winning_overs_with_null_bowler,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_totals AS r
     LEFT JOIN bowling AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
     WHERE b.match_id IS NULL) AS scoring_overs_without_bowling,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM run_entries WHERE runs IS NULL) AS null_run_entries,
    AVG(CASE WHEN chronological_rank = 1 THEN total_runs END) AS average_max_runs
FROM winning

WITH over_totals AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id,
           SUM(COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) + COALESCE(e.extra_runs, 0)) AS total_runs,
           COUNT(DISTINCT b.bowler) AS bowler_count
    FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
    LEFT JOIN main.batsman_scored AS s USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
    LEFT JOIN main.extra_runs AS e USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
    GROUP BY b.match_id, b.innings_no, b.over_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC, innings_no, over_id
    ) AS over_rank
    FROM over_totals
)
SELECT
    sqlite_version() AS sqlite_version,
    COUNT(*) AS matches_with_deliveries,
    SUM(m.match_id IS NULL) AS delivery_matches_outside_catalog,
    GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN m.match_id IS NULL THEN r.match_id END) AS match_ids_outside_catalog,
    SUM(r.bowler_count > 1) AS selected_overs_with_multiple_bowlers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.batsman_scored AS s
     LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)
     WHERE b.match_id IS NULL) AS unmatched_batsman_entries,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.extra_runs AS e
     LEFT JOIN main.ball_by_ball AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id, ball_id)

    AVG(r.total_runs) AS overall_average,
    AVG(CASE WHEN m.match_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.total_runs END) AS catalog_average
